state.document: Each entry under pages is one rendered page of a single resume, in reading order. The images are the only record of the document layout.

layout.instructions: How is the body text of the resume in `pages.p1` arranged?

criteria.one_column: All body text sits in one vertical column.
criteria.two_columns: Body text is arranged in two vertical columns.
criteria.three_or_more_columns: Body text is arranged in three or more vertical columns.
criteria.table: Body text sits in ruled or aligned table cells.
criteria.mixed: The page mixes columns, tables or full-width blocks.

readable.instructions: Is every part of this resume page readable at this resolution, with no blur, clipping or unreadable text?

content_present.instructions: Does this resume page show any visible text at all?

p1_margins.instructions: Judge only the margins of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Content keeps a clear margin on all four sides and nothing touches an edge.
criteria.minor: One margin is tight or uneven, but no content touches an edge.
criteria.major: Content touches or crosses a page edge, or the margins are very uneven.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_margins_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the margins

p1_alignment.instructions: Judge only the alignment of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Text blocks share few left edges and line up on a clear vertical grid.
criteria.minor: One block is misaligned or indented differently from the rest.
criteria.major: Several blocks use different left edges, so the page looks ragged.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_alignment_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the alignment

p1_hierarchy.instructions: Judge only the hierarchy of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Section headings are clearly larger or bolder than body text, consistently.
criteria.minor: One heading breaks the size or weight pattern used by the other headings.
criteria.major: Headings are hard to tell apart from body text, or the pattern changes often.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_hierarchy_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the hierarchy

p1_spacing.instructions: Judge only the spacing of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Space between sections and entries follows a repeatable rhythm.
criteria.minor: One gap is clearly larger or smaller than the rest.
criteria.major: Spacing is erratic, or entries run together with no gap.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_spacing_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the spacing

p1_density.instructions: Judge only the density of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Line length and white space keep the page easy to read.
criteria.minor: Some lines run long or the text is slightly crowded.
criteria.major: Lines span the full page width or the text is packed with no breathing room.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_density_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the density

p1_entry_format.instructions: Judge only the entry format of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Every entry in a section uses the same title, date and bullet pattern.
criteria.minor: One entry breaks the pattern used by its neighbours.
criteria.major: Entries in the same section follow two or more different patterns.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_entry_format_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the entry format

p1_page_balance.instructions: Judge only the page balance of the resume page in `pages.p1`.

criteria.pass: Content fills the page evenly without a large empty area.
criteria.minor: The page ends with a noticeable empty area, or is slightly crowded.
criteria.major: A large part of the page is empty, or the page is badly overcrowded.
criteria.unable_to_assess: The page is unreadable or does not show this property.

p1_page_balance_box.instructions: the part of the resume in `pages.p1` that shows the page balance

p1_header_present.instructions: Does `pages.p1` contain the applicant name and contact details at the top?

p1_header_box.instructions: the applicant name and contact details at the top in `pages.p1`
